climate_context.noaa_homogenization_caveat: Raw GHCN-Daily station records are unhomogenized for time-of-observation bias (TOBS), sensor transitions (liquid-in-glass to MMTS/electronic), or micro-site relocations across the 1944-1999 hiatus; century-scale era shifts provide contextual background rather than formal climate-attribution estimates.
